source.label: Extreme eigenvalues of the complete-grid Gram form with one off-line pair

reviewer: Claude Code proof assessment; fresh medium reviewer

claims.summary: Complete-grid Gram model, one off-axis pair of multiplicity m at distance delta and any real points, G = G_on + B: m(kappa+1) <= lambda_max(G) <= m(kappa+1) + lambda_max(G_on) and -m(kappa-1) <= lambda_min(G) <= min(0, -m(kappa-1) + eta), eta = e_y^T G_on e_y <= lambda_max(G_on); flat window: lambda_max(G_on) <= M_loc(3 + (2/pi)(1 + ln K)). So an operator-norm bound B at bandwidth Lam gives delta <= (log B + log(4 delta Lam))/Lam for a solitary pair with delta Lam >= 1, and a one-sided bound lambda_min >= -B the same with B + 1 + eta.
claims.assessment: Working elementary proof (test vectors e_x, e_y and Weyl). A small refinement of solitary amplification, whose part 4 already has the lower bound for lambda_max; added is the upper bound for lambda_min with its margin, and the observation that the extreme eigenvalues, unlike the second moment, see a solitary pair once kappa exceeds the on-line part's size, also at bandwidth log T. Complete grid only; the cut grid is not treated. The premise (an eigenvalue bound of size T^eps for the import's form) is not available, follows from the goal in the model, and is expected to be a local restatement of it.
claims.rationale: Replaces the earlier reading that the Gram mechanism needs bandwidth beyond log T, which holds for the Hilbert-Schmidt norm only; names the premise at the import's own bandwidth.
claims.next_action: Derive the prime side of the quadratic form at bandwidth log T from the import's explicit formula and state which sum over prime powers bounds the extreme eigenvalues.
claims.formalization_scope: Not formalized; no Lean work assigned.

notes.mathematical_status: Complete proof in the entry for every window (the on-line bound for the flat window); control on 18 configurations, including real points denser than the grid.
notes.significance: Context: a refinement that changes which premise the model's route needs; not a result about zeta. Novelty not claimed.
notes.relationships: Refines solitary amplification (adds the upper bound for lambda_max and both bounds for lambda_min); uses the pair atom spectrum and the real configuration bound.
